sections.markdown:
# Verify list

Preserve the registered source effective-date, retrieval-evidence and rights-review debts. School-bus exceptions must retain the difference between one-lane-each-way center-turn roads and wider four- or five-lane roads; do not flatten the rule to all medians. Current statute and traffic-stop procedure remain legal/currentness review debt. The roundabout speed on physical96 differs from physical42 and the same-time yield-to-right wording on physical97 risks confusion with yielding to circulating traffic from the left; these unresolved source details are not taught as additional rules. Speed-survival absolutes and dated impact comparisons are not adopted. Do not read the source minimum-speed summary as permission to maintain a dangerous speed in poor conditions. Keep every stated condition attached to its page-cited rule. Unknown examination count and duration remain null. Revision frequency has not been established and the blocked-probe declaration remains. Independent source and factual review must address these precise points; authored market and competitor gaps remain separate from driving facts.

corpus_stability.reason: Registered handbook snapshot only; effective-date, rights, source freshness and independent factual review debts remain. No unsupported revision-frequency claim.
